decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed is significantly diluted with accessories rather than speakers, including charging cables, travel cases, wall shelves, and power adapters, which reduces the immediate variety of high-quality hardware to choose from. While the consideration set includes the most promising speakers, each has notable drawbacks: the DOSS SoundBox Pro+ (prod_008) is relatively expensive at $89.99, the EDUPLINK (prod_051) has conflicting reviews regarding terrible sound quality despite its popularity, and the Ortizan (prod_103) shows reports of inconsistent Bluetooth pairing. Because no single product perfectly balances high-fidelity sound, reliable connectivity, and fair pricing among the options provided, I have decided not to make a purchase at this time.
